translated_text: \subsection{{微分形式的完全多项式空间}}\label{sec:complete-polynomial-forms}

source_text: {The assembled finite element space is then defined to consist of all functions on $\Omega$ whose restriction to each $T$ belongs to the shape function space $V(T)$ and for which the DOFs are single-valued (in the sense that when two elements share a common face, the corresponding DOFs on the face take the same value).}
translated_text: {组装后的有限元空间定义为 $\Omega$ 上所有满足下列条件的函数: 在每个 $T$ 上的限制属于形函数空间 $V(T)$, 且自由度是单值的 (即两个单元共享一个面时, 面上的相应自由度取相同值).}
